summary: Resolved the gate20 eager-load context-budget overage via route (a): audited the eager set, found two genuine duplicate-content sections (rules/artifact-formats.md's Phase Status Markers, memory/EXTENSION.md's /distill table and lifecycle diagram) and relocated them to their already-existing non-eager homes after verifying presence there, recovering 1,488 B of headroom under the unmoved 66,800 B baseline.
